user.title: Set up HA Whisker Pet ID
user.description: Connects to your existing Whisker (litterrobot) integration to expose Litter-Robot 5 Pet ID visits, camera clips, and visit reassignment actions.

error.no_litterrobot_lr5: No loaded Whisker integration with a Litter-Robot 5 was found. Configure and load the official Whisker integration first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

get_pets.name: Get Whisker Pets
get_pets.description: List all Whisker pet profiles with baseline weights, tags, and recent weight history.

refresh.name: Refresh from Cloud
refresh.description: Force a fresh GraphQL fetch of pet profiles and weight histories before returning.

list_visits.name: List LR5 Visits
list_visits.description: Fetch recent Litter-Robot 5 activities, join matching Pet ID camera clips, and flag misattributions.

robot.name: Robot
robot.description: Optional Litter-Robot 5 name or serial (defaults to sole LR5 unit).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of activity records to retrieve.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Number of activity records to skip for pagination.

activity_type.name: Activity Type
activity_type.description: Filter activity type (e.g. PET_VISIT, or empty string for all events).

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD local date filter for clips and visits.

include_clips.name: Include Camera Clips
include_clips.description: Join matching LR5 Pro camera clips by event ID or timestamp proximity.

max_clip_delta_seconds.name: Max Clip Delta Seconds
max_clip_delta_seconds.description: Maximum seconds between a visit timestamp and a camera clip timestamp to treat as a match.

get_clip_urls.name: Get LR5 Clip URLs
get_clip_urls.description: Exchange a recorded LR5 Pro clip ID for short-lived presigned S3 MP4 chunk URLs and HLS cookies.

clip_id.name: Clip ID
clip_id.description: The recorded camera clip ID from list_visits.

reassign_visit.name: Reassign LR5 Pet Visit
reassign_visit.description: Reassign, assign, or unassign a Litter-Robot 5 PET_VISIT event via Whisker's REST API.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The eventId of the PET_VISIT activity to modify.

from_pet.name: From Pet
from_pet.description: Name or petId currently assigned to the visit (provide alone to unassign, or with to_pet to reassign).

to_pet.name: To Pet
to_pet.description: Name or petId to assign the visit to (omit to unassign).

refresh.name: Refresh Sensors
refresh.description: Refresh Home Assistant's Litter-Robot and Pet ID coordinators after updating.
